root_cause.text: The function `e1000_tbi_should_accept()` in the e1000 driver performs an out-of-bounds read by dereferencing `data[length - 1]` without first validating that the descriptor-reported length is non-zero and within the RX buffer size (`adapter->rx_buffer_len`).
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit guards `if (unlikely(!length)) return false;` and `if (unlikely(length > adapter->rx_buffer_len)) return false;` before accessing the last byte, and the CVE description states: "This happens because the TBI check unconditionally dereferences the last byte without validating the reported length first: u8 last_byte = *(data + length - 1);"
